review.notes: Full read-through of all OCR lines against extracted text from all 26 physical PDF pages; pages 3, 15, 16, 22 and 23 were additionally rendered and visually inspected. Page 22 confirmed the printed prompt reads 'stylized artistic subtitles'; page 23 confirmed reference [22] prints 'Dancegrpo: Unleashing grpo on visual generation' (the reported grupo/grpo class) and that reference [9] really prints 'Seed1. 5-vl' with the space, so it is kept as printed. Page 3 confirmed the official-page URL ends seedance2_0 with a bare underscore. The printed Rank Spread '1<->1' wording on p.6 matches the source. The sentence 'Kling 3.0 is competitive on fine motion IP...' is split by the physical page break between p.15 and p.16, and OCR wedged Table 14 between the two halves; the two rejoin patches restore the printed word order without moving the table. Superscript access markers on p.3 (Doubao^1, Jimeng^2) survive in OCR as $^{1}$/$^{2}$. Figure-banner text (e.g. 'PGC Scene T2V Comparison') exists only inside figure images and is correctly absent from prose. The contributor name list after the acknowledgments table is flattened to plain name-per-line rows, matching the printed multi-column layout; no names were dropped.

patches.evidence: Rendered physical p.22 (Figure 4, bottom I2V strip caption) prints 'At the bottom of the frame, stylized artistic subtitles appear alongside a voiceover'; OCR misread the word as 'subtiles' (visually verified at 300 dpi).
